Henry Meller ran up a 12.
David Mullin carded a 9.
Stuart Neumann arrived last and posted a 10, a sextuple bogey against a par of 4.
Gregg Williams closed out round four at Boavista with a gross 35-over.
A 9 at the par-5 3rd.
An 8 at the par-4 7th.
Another 8 at the par-4 12th.
Three straight bogeys, and with strokes received, three shots gained against par.
Double bogeys at the 15th, 16th and 18th, with a triple at the 17th sitting in the middle of them.
He bled nine shots over the closing four holes.
It left Jon Baker as Trophy leader after the round, with David Mullin leading the separate Green Jacket race.
